stock.description: TIL Enviro Limited, a company based in the People's Republic of China, specializes in providing wastewater treatment and construction solutions primarily within the Ningxia region. Its core activities include the provision of purified, recycled water for a diverse range of applications, such as industrial use, landscape irrigation, power generation facilities, and public institutions. Additionally, TIL Enviro offers expert consultancy services. The company is responsible for the operation and management of four wastewater treatment facilities situated in Yinchuan, employing a transfer-operate-transfer (TOT) business model. Established in 2011, its corporate headquarters are located in Guangzhou, PRC. TIL Enviro Limited operates as a subsidiary of Sparkle Century Group Limited.
